source_summary: Tall Chinese landscape with blue-green mountains, misty water, wooded peninsulas, village architecture, pavilions, bridges, and scholar residence; seals, calligraphy, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: left_main_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant blue-green mountain rising on the upper left, including its rounded summit, descending ribbed ridges, shaded gullies, and dark pine clusters along the left flank and lower saddles; exclude the village roofs below and seals in the sky.
must_preserve: dark ink contour line along the summit
parallel hemp-fiber texture strokes on the slopes
soft blue-green mineral wash
warm ochre ridge highlights
black pine-needle clusters on the lower left shoulder
mist-softened lower edges where the mountain descends toward the valley

motifs.name: distant_misty_hill_chain
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-to-far distance hill chain across the upper center and right: small rounded peaks, low undulating ridges, pale lake mist, and faint shoreline bands; exclude the main left mountain and any seals or inscriptions.
must_preserve: pale ink silhouettes of far peaks
soft horizontal mist edges
delicate dotted texture on hill crests
light blue-green wash on rounded slopes
subtle ochre undertone
thin shoreline strokes fading into water

motifs.name: upper_left_lakeside_village
motifs.description: Isolate the small village cluster at the upper-left lakeside, with several tiled-roof buildings tucked among leafless trees, pines, low fences, and pale water channels; exclude the large mountain mass behind it except for immediate grounding slopes.
must_preserve: fine roof geometry and dark roof ridges
fence and wall linework
bare tree branch tracery
dense black pine needles at the village edge
pale water wash around the houses
small red leaf accents among the shrubs

motifs.name: central_stilt_pavilion_peninsula
motifs.description: Isolate the central waterside pavilion on stilts with its narrow roof, railings, supporting posts, adjacent blue-green rocky peninsula, and leaning red-leaved tree; exclude the larger surrounding lake and unrelated distant hills.
must_preserve: thin ink roof outlines and eave angles
vertical stilt and railing strokes
blue-green wash on the rocky mound
leaning tree trunk and branch linework
red dotted foliage accents
small shoreline grasses and dark moss dots

motifs.name: middle_wooded_peninsula
motifs.description: Isolate the middle-left wooded peninsula projecting into the water, with clusters of tall leafless trees, rounded blue-green knolls, ochre banks, and a winding shoreline; avoid including the central pavilion and lower bridge.
must_preserve: interlaced bare branch networks
slender vertical trunks with dark ink outlines
rounded blue-green rock washes
dry-brush contour strokes on banks
small red foliage dots
soft shoreline transitions into pale water

motifs.name: lower_left_bridge_terraced_banks
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left stream crossing and terraced banks: the small plank bridge with posts, layered ochre-green shores, eroded rock ledges, and sparse grasses along the watercourse; exclude the large foreground blue rock and central groves.
must_preserve: tiny bridge planks and vertical support posts
stepped shoreline contour lines
dark dry-brush rock ledges
pale water channel left unpainted
low moss and grass dotting
ochre and blue-green wash transitions on the banks

motifs.name: lower_right_scholar_residence_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right scholar residence complex with tiled roofs, open room, veranda, fence, seated figures, tall trees, pines, bamboo-like foliage, and nearby willow; exclude the calligraphy at the far lower right.
must_preserve: precise tiled roof geometry
open interior wall and window linework
tiny seated scholar figures inside the room
fence panels and gate strokes
tall bare trunks rising through the compound
dark pine and bamboo foliage textures
pale willow branches and red leaf accents

motifs.name: foreground_blue_cliff_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground blue cliff-like rock formation near the lower center, together with attached smaller rocks, low shrubs, dark moss, and the twisting bare tree beside it; exclude the residence above and the far-right inscription area.
must_preserve: saturated blue-green mineral wash on the vertical rock face
dark contour lines and internal crevice strokes
rounded smaller boulders at the base
dry-brush moss dots along the foot of the rocks
twisting bare tree trunk and fine branches
warm ochre shadows and red foliage specks

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
